set.body: Found by S3.7 slice 4 (p0-s37 93ddd7a4). eyes4s-fs2 study-run meter/completion errors and execution defects have no Diagnose instance, so the real backend can only report them as Unavailable(Run) naming the defect. Add Diagnose[StudyRunError] with catalog codes, append-only.
set.title: Diagnose[StudyRunError] for study execution failures
